mappings.key_fact: Enterprise customer (Meridian Retail Group) paused orders in July after three of five June deliveries missed SLA; switched volume to competitor SwiftKart's new express program launched July 1
Enterprise customer (Kalinga Mart) renewal at risk due to four June PO delivery misses; procurement actively evaluating SwiftKart's competing express program
WH-07 main conveyor failure on June 25 reduced North-West throughput to 60% and caused staffing shortfall; ops predicted SLA breaches on North-West lanes persisting until repair (3-week ETA)
Manual sortation at WH-07 holding at 60% throughput as of July 3; backlog of 1,900 orders with oldest aged 5 days; complaint volume climbing for late deliveries
Consumer order delivered 3 days late (promised 2 days, delivered day 6) in early July due to WH-07 dispatch delay; customer requested refund
Brand refresh is purely visual (logo/typography); no checkout or tracking changes

new_hypothesis.label: North-West warehouse conveyor failure in late June caused order fulfillment SLA breaches and delivery delays through July, triggering enterprise customer churn to competitor and increased consumer order cancellations/refund requests, directly reducing marketing conversion rate
